featureFlagOmnirouteEmergencyFallbackDes: Tura buƙatun da kasafin kuɗinsu ya ƙare zuwa provider/model na gaggawa mai kyauta.
featureFlagArenaEloSyncEnabledDescriptio: Kunna daidaita ELO na jadawalin jagorancin Arena AI lokaci-lokaci domin martabar ƙwarewar samfura.
featureFlagUniversalContextHandoffEnable: Ƙirƙira da shigar da taƙaitattun tattaunawa lokacin da tsarin tura haɗe-haɗe ya sauya samfura. Kashe wannan domin ɗaukar sauyin samfura daban-daban da kuma hana buƙatun miƙa aiki na bayan fage ga duk haɗe-haɗe na yanzu da na gaba.
featureFlagExposeCcDiscoveryAliasesDescr: Bayyana ID na madubi na claude/<provider>/<model> a /v1/models domin gano samfuran gateway na Claude Code ya jera samfuran da ba na Claude ba. Gargadi: idan aka kunna wannan a ko’ina, zai ninka shigarwar kundin ga duk abokan hulɗa.
featureFlagNoThinkingAliasEnabledDescrip: Babban maɓalli na aliases na gateway na no-think/<provider>/<model>. Kunne (tsoho): /v1/models yana bayyana nau'in da ba ya yin tunani ga kowane samfurin Claude mai ikon tunani da ya cancanta, kuma ID na no-think/ da aka aika cikin buƙata yana komawa ga ainihin samfurin tare da hana yin nazari. Kashe: ba a bayyana kowane nau'i, kuma ana ɗaukar ID na no-think/ kamar kowane ID na samfurin da ba a sani ba. Zaɓin shiga/fita na ModelSpec.noThinkingAlias na kowane samfurin yana ci gaba da aiki yayin da wannan yake kunne.
featureFlagChatVirtualLanesEnabledDescri: Kunna layukan karɓa na kama-da-wane masu daidaitawa ga kowane tenant domin aika buƙatu zuwa provider (#9654): yawaitar buƙatun tenant ɗaya ba za ta sake jawo wa wani kuskuren 503 ba. Env var na OMNIROUTE_CHAT_VIRTUAL_LANES yana da fifiko kan wannan sauyin dashboard; sauye-sauye za su fara aiki bayan sake kunna server.

howItWorks.step1: Zaɓi mai samar da haɗin kai (misali Slack, Discord, custom webhook) sannan ka saita bayanan haɗin.
howItWorks.step2: Saita abubuwan da ke faruwa a tsarin da za a yi rajista da su (misali kurakuran kammalawa, komawa ga wasu models, ko iyakokin amfani).
howItWorks.step3: Tabbatar da saitin ta hanyar aika payload na gwaji domin tabbatar da cewa endpoint ɗin yana karɓarsa.
howItWorks.step4: Kare endpoint ɗinka ta hanyar tabbatar da X-Webhook-Signature HMAC-SHA256 header ta amfani da sirrin webhook.
howItWorks.title: Yadda Webhooks Ke Aiki
howItWorks.customOnly: Ya shafi haɗaɗɗun mahaɗan ƙarshe na musamman kawai.
howItWorks.hmacRecipe: Don tabbatar da bayanan webhook a Node.js, ƙididdige HMAC-SHA256 na ainihin jikin buƙatar ta amfani da maɓallin sirrinka. Kwatanta shi da kanun X-Webhook-Signature ta amfani da timingSafeEqual.
howItWorks.timeoutNote: Isar da webhook na da iyakar lokaci na daƙiƙa 10.
howItWorks.retryNote: Ana sake ƙoƙarin isar da bayanan da suka gaza har sau 5 tare da ƙara tsawon jinkiri a hankali.
howItWorks.docsLink: Karanta cikakken jagorar masu haɓakawa na Webhooks
howItWorks.hmacRecipePython: Tabbatar da HMAC na Python: hmac.new(secret, body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
howItWorks.hmacRecipeBash: Tabbatar da HMAC na Bash: echo -n "$body" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$secret"

toolUseCases.claude: Yi amfani da shi lokacin da kake son ingantattun hanyoyin tsara aiki da dogayen gyare-gyare a fayiloli da yawa ta amfani da Claude Code.
toolUseCases.codex: Yi amfani da shi lokacin da ƙungiyarku ta daidaita kan tsarin ayyukan OpenAI Codex CLI da tantancewa bisa bayanin martaba.
toolUseCases.droid: Yi amfani da shi lokacin da kake buƙatar wakilin tasha mai sauƙi wanda ya mayar da hankali kan saurin rubuta lamba da maimaita aiwatar da umarni.
toolUseCases.openclaw: Yi amfani da shi lokacin da kake son wakilin rubuta lamba irin na Open Claw amma ana sarrafa hanyarsa ta manufofin OmniRoute.
toolUseCases.cline: Yi amfani da shi lokacin da kake saita wakilan rubuta lamba a cikin editoci kuma kake son jagorar saitawa tare da samfuran OmniRoute.
toolUseCases.kilo: Yi amfani da shi lokacin da tsarin aikinka ya dogara da umarnin Kilo Code da saurin gyare-gyare akai-akai.
toolUseCases.cursor: Yi amfani da shi lokacin rubuta lamba a Cursor kuma kana buƙatar samfura na musamman masu dacewa da OpenAI ta hanyar OmniRoute.
toolUseCases.continue: Yi amfani da shi lokacin gudanar da Continue a cikin IDEs kuma kana buƙatar saitin mai samarwa mai sauƙin ɗauka wanda ya dogara da JSON.
toolUseCases.opencode: Yi amfani da shi lokacin da ka fi son gudanar da wakili kai tsaye a tasha da sarrafa ayyuka ta atomatik ta hanyar rubutattun umarni ta amfani da OpenCode.
toolUseCases.kiro: Yi amfani da shi lokacin haɗa Kiro da sarrafa hanyoyin samfura daga wuri guda a OmniRoute.
toolUseCases.windsurf: Yi amfani da shi lokacin da kake son IDE da aka gina da AI a matsayin jigo, tare da sarrafa hanyoyin samfuran Codeium/Windsurf ta hanyar OmniRoute.
toolUseCases.antigravity: Yi amfani da shi lokacin da dole ne a katse zirga-zirgar Antigravity/Kiro ta hanyar MITM sannan a tura ta zuwa OmniRoute.
toolUseCases.copilot: Yi amfani da shi lokacin da kake son ƙwarewar mai amfani irin ta tattaunawar Copilot yayin tilasta amfani da maɓallan OmniRoute da ƙa'idojin sarrafa hanya.
toolUseCases.amp: Yi amfani da shi lokacin da kake son gajerun hanyoyin aiki na Amp amma har yanzu kana buƙatar tilasta dokokin laƙabi da sarrafa hanya na OmniRoute.
toolUseCases.hermes: Yi amfani da shi lokacin da kake buƙatar mataimakin AI mai sauƙi da ke aiki kai tsaye a tasha don ayyuka masu sauri.
toolUseCases.hermes-agent: Yi amfani da wannan idan kana buƙatar Hermes Agent (na Nousresearch) tare da tsoffin samfura, na wakilci, na gani da na taimako waɗanda ake bi da su ta OmniRoute.
toolUseCases.custom: Yi amfani da wannan don aiwatar da kayan aiki na musamman ko saitunan gama-gari masu dacewa da OpenAI.

combos.roundRobinDesc: Rarrabawar zagaye: kowace buƙata tana zuwa model na gaba a juyawa
combos.contextRelayDesc: Yana kiyaye ci gaban zaman tare da taƙaitaccen bayani na miƙa aiki lokacin da ake juyawa tsakanin asusu
combos.randomDesc: Zaɓi bazuwar daidai, sannan a koma ga sauran models idan ya gaza
combos.leastUsedDesc: Yana zaɓar model mai mafi ƙarancin buƙatu, yana daidaita nauyi a tsawon lokaci
combos.costOptimizedDesc: Yana fara tura buƙata zuwa model mafi arha bisa farashi
combos.cacheOptimizedDesc: Yana tura kowane prefix na prompt da za a iya sake amfani da shi zuwa asusun provider ɗaya a kai a kai
combos.resetAware: RR Mai La'akari da Sake Saiti
combos.resetAwareDesc: Yana daidaita ragowar quota da lokutan sake saiti na 5h da na mako-mako, sannan ya yi round-robin ga maki masu kama
combos.quotaWeightedDesc: A tsallake asusun da quota ɗinsu ya ƙare, sannan a zaɓa daga sauran gwargwadon abin da ya rage, bayan an raba da nauyin buƙatun da ke gudana. Tattaunawar da ake yi za ta ci gaba da kasancewa a asusun da aka ɗaure ta.
combos.strictRandomDesc: Cakuɗa katunan — yana amfani da kowane model sau ɗaya kafin sake cakuɗawa
combos.fusionDesc: Yana aika prompt zuwa kowane model na panel a lokaci guda, sannan judge model ya haɗa amsoshi ya samar da amsa ta ƙarshe guda ɗaya
combos.fusionJudgeModelHelp: Model da ke haɗa amsoshin panel zuwa amsa ta ƙarshe guda ɗaya. A barshi babu komai don amfani da model na farko a panel.
combos.fusionMinPanelHelp: Ana buƙatar amsoshin panel masu nasara kafin a ba masu jinkiri lokacin rangwame (tsoho 2).
combos.fusionStragglerGraceMsHelp: Tsawon lokacin jiran samfuran panel masu jinkiri bayan an kai adadin da ake buƙata (tsoho 8000).
combos.fusionPanelHardTimeoutMsHelp: Cikakkiyar iyaka don kada samfurin da ya maƙale ya tsaida dukkan panel ɗin (tsoho 90000).
combos.contextRelayHandoffThresholdHelp: Idan amfani da kason ya kai wannan matsayi, OmniRoute zai samar da taƙaitaccen bayanin miƙa aiki mai tsari kafin asusun da ke aiki ya ƙare.
combos.contextRelayMaxMessagesHelp: Yana iyakance adadin tarihin baya-bayan nan da ake taƙaitawa cikin taƙaitaccen bayanin relay.
combos.contextRelaySummaryModelHelp: Samfurin maye na zaɓi da ake amfani da shi kawai don samar da taƙaitaccen bayanin miƙa aiki. Bar shi babu komai don sake amfani da samfurin combo da ke aiki.
combos.contextRelayProviderNote: A halin yanzu Context Relay yana samar da miƙa aiki don jujjuya asusun Codex. Haɗa shi da asusu da yawa na mai samarwa ɗaya don samun mafi kyawun ci gaba.
combos.advancedHint: Bar shi babu komai don amfani da tsoffin saitunan gama-gari. Waɗannan suna maye gurbin saitunan kowane mai samarwa.
combos.liveNoProviders: Ba a ga masu samarwa ba tukuna.
combos.liveFleetDataHint: Bayanan runduna suna zuwa ta abubuwan combo kai tsaye.
combos.liveNoRun: Babu aikin combo da ake da shi.
combos.liveDataHint: Bayanan kai tsaye suna zuwa ta tashar combo ta WebSocket.
combos.liveDisconnected: An kashe kai tsaye — WebSocket ya yanke haɗi. Ana nuna yanayin ƙarshe da aka sani.
combos.playgroundDescription: Kwaikwayi yadda za a bi da buƙatu ta cikin haɗe-haɗenka
combos.playgroundEmptyHint: Zaɓi haɗe-haɗe sannan ka danna Kwaikwayi Hanyar Bi don ganin hanyar bi.
combos.playgroundNoCombosYet: Har yanzu ba a saita haɗe-haɗe ba.
combos.strategyGuideTitle: Yadda ake amfani da wannan dabarar

priority.when: Kana da samfurin da ka fi so guda ɗaya kuma kana son amfani da madadin ne kawai idan ya gaza.
priority.avoid: Kana buƙatar rarraba buƙatu tsakanin samfura.
priority.example: Babban samfurin rubuta lamba tare da madadin mai rahusa don lokacin katsewar aiki.

weighted.when: Kana buƙatar sarrafa rabon zirga-zirga tsakanin samfura.
weighted.avoid: Ba za ka iya kiyaye ingantattun nauyi a tsawon lokaci ba.
weighted.example: Fitar da ingantaccen samfuri 80% + samfurin gwaji 20%.

round-robin.when: Kana son rarrabawa mai sauƙin hasashe kuma daidai.
round-robin.avoid: Samfura sun bambanta sosai ta fuskar jinkiri ko farashi.
round-robin.example: Samfuri iri ɗaya a asusu da yawa don rarraba yawan buƙatu.

random.when: Kana son sauƙin rarrabawa tare da saitawa mafi ƙanƙanta.
random.example: Gwajin samfuri cikin sauri da samfura masu daidaito.

least-used.when: Kana son daidaitawa ta atomatik bisa buƙatar da ake da ita kai tsaye.
least-used.avoid: Zirga-zirga ta yi ƙasa sosai har ba za a amfana daga daidaita amfani ba.
least-used.example: Ayyuka gauraye inda wani samfuri kan cika da aiki akai-akai.

cost-optimized.when: Rage farashi shi ne babban fifikonka.
cost-optimized.avoid: Bayanan farashi sun ɓace ko sun tsufa.
cost-optimized.example: Ayyukan bango ko na rukuni inda aka fi son ƙananan farashi.

reset-aware.when: Kana karkatar da buƙatu tsakanin asusu da yawa masu bayanan quota da lokutan sake saiti daban-daban.
reset-aware.avoid: Ba a samun bayanan quota ga yawancin asusu.
reset-aware.example: Fi son asusun mako-mako mai 60% wanda zai sake saitawa gobe maimakon asusun 80% wanda zai sake saitawa daga baya.

strict-random.when: Yi amfani da wannan idan kana son rarrabawa daidai ƙwarai — ana amfani da kowane samfuri sau ɗaya kafin a maimaita.
strict-random.avoid: Ka guje wa wannan idan samfura suna da bambancin inganci ko jinkiri kuma jeri yana da muhimmanci.
strict-random.example: Misali: Asusu da yawa na samfuri iri ɗaya don rarraba amfani daidai.

p2c.when: Yi amfani da wannan idan kana son zaɓi mai ƙarancin jinkiri ta amfani da tsarin Power-of-Two-Choices.
p2c.avoid: Ka guje wa wannan ga ƙananan haɗaka masu samfura 2 ko ƙasa da haka — ba shi da wata fa’ida fiye da round-robin.
p2c.example: Misali: Aiwatar da inference mai yawan buƙatu a wuraren ƙarshen samfura masu daidaito guda 4 ko fiye.

context-relay.when: Yi amfani da wannan idan dogayen zaman aiki dole su ci gaba yayin sauya asusu ba tare da rasa mahallin aikin ba.
context-relay.avoid: Ka guje wa wannan idan ba kasafai ake sauya asusu ba ko kuma ba ka son ƙarin buƙatun taƙaitawa.
context-relay.example: Misali: Zaman Codex waɗanda ke sauyawa tsakanin asusu da yawa yayin da quota ke gab da ƙarewa.

fill-first.when: Yi amfani da wannan idan kana son ƙare quota na wani mai samarwa gaba ɗaya kafin komawa na gaba.
fill-first.avoid: Ka guje wa wannan idan kana buƙatar daidaita nauyi a matakin buƙata tsakanin masu samarwa.
fill-first.example: Misali: Yi amfani da dukkan kuɗin kiredit na Deepgram na $200 kafin komawa Groq.

auto.when: Yi amfani da wannan idan kana buƙatar karkatarwa bisa ƙididdigar abubuwa da yawa kamar farashi, jinkiri, da inganci.
auto.avoid: Ka guje wa wannan idan kana buƙatar tsayayyen jerin fifiko ko adana tarihin baya.
auto.example: Misali: Daidaita buƙatu tsakanin samfura masu ƙwarewa daban-daban.

lkgp.when: Yi amfani da wannan idan kana son karkatarwa bisa adadin nasarorin baya da ingancin aiki.
lkgp.avoid: Ka guje wa wannan idan bayanan tarihi kaɗan ne ko ba abin dogaro ba ne.
lkgp.example: Misali: Karkatar da buƙatu zuwa samfura masu kyakkyawan tarihin aiwatar da takamaiman ayyuka.

context-optimized.when: Yi amfani da wannan idan kana buƙatar inganta amfani da tagar mahalli tsakanin samfura.
context-optimized.avoid: Ka guje wa wannan idan samfura suna da tsawon mahalli iri ɗaya ko ayyukan suna da sauƙi.
context-optimized.example: Misali: Rarraba dogayen tattaunawa tsakanin samfura masu manyan tagogin mahalli.

advancedHelp.maxRetries: Yawan sake gwadawa kafin a ɗauki cewa buƙata ta gaza.
advancedHelp.retryDelay: Jiran farko tsakanin sake gwadawa. Ƙimomi mafi girma suna rage matsin buƙatu na lokaci guda.
advancedHelp.timeout: Matsakaicin tsawon lokacin buƙata kafin a soke ta.
advancedHelp.healthcheck: Yana cire samfura/masu samarwa marasa lafiya daga shawarwarin karkatarwa.
advancedHelp.concurrencyPerModel: Matsakaicin buƙatun lokaci guda da aka yarda da su ga kowane samfuri a round-robin.
advancedHelp.queueTimeout: Tsawon lokacin da buƙata za ta iya jira a jerin gwano kafin lokacinta ya ƙare.
advancedHelp.failoverBeforeRetry: Idan an kunna, duk wani kuskuren upstream zai jawo sauyawa nan take zuwa combo target na gaba, tare da tsallake duk sake-gwaje da fallback URLs.
advancedHelp.maxSetRetries: Adadin lokutan sake gwada cikakken rukunin targets idan duk targets suka gaza. 0 = babu sake-gwaji a matakin rukuni.
advancedHelp.setRetryDelayMs: Jinkiri tsakanin yunƙurin sake-gwaji a matakin rukuni, domin ba matsalolin wucin gadi lokaci su warware.
advancedHelp.disableSessionStickiness: Sauya zuwa wata connection daban a kowace buƙata maimakon ɗaure duk tattaunawa da connection guda ta hanyar hash na saƙon farko. Wannan ya rinjayi saitin gama-gari na asali. Bar shi a Inherit domin kiyaye samun prompt-cache a tattaunawa masu zagaye da yawa.

combos.templatesDescription: Aiwatar da profile na farawa, sannan daidaita models da config.
combos.templateHighAvailabilityDesc: Routing bisa fifiko tare da health checks da amintattun sake-gwaje.
combos.templateCostSaverDesc: Routing da aka inganta don rage kuɗi ga ayyukan da kasafin kuɗi ya fi muhimmanci.
combos.templateBalancedDesc: Routing zuwa mafi ƙarancin amfani domin rarraba buƙata a tsawon lokaci.
combos.quickTestDescription: Gudanar da gwaji yanzu don tabbatar da halayen fallback da latency.
combos.pricingCoverageHint: Cost-optimized yana aiki mafi kyau idan duk combo models suna da bayanan farashi.
combos.fallbackOnlyOnQuotaExhaustion: Ci gaba ne kawai idan quota ta ƙare
combos.warningRoundRobinSingleModel: Round-robin ya fi amfani idan akwai aƙalla models 2.
combos.warningCostOptimizedPartialPricing: Models {priced} ne kawai daga cikin {total} suke da bayanan farashi. Routing na iya yin la’akari da kuɗi a wani ɓangare kawai.
combos.warningCostOptimizedNoPricing: Ba a sami bayanan farashi na wannan combo ba. Cost-optimized na iya yin routing ba kamar yadda ake tsammani ba.
combos.filterEmptyTitle: Babu combos da suka dace da wannan tacewar strategy.
combos.filterEmptyIntelligentDescription: Ƙirƙiri auto ko LKGP combo domin cike dashboard na intelligent routing.
combos.filterEmptyDeterministicDescription: Auto da LKGP combos ne kawai suke akwai a yanzu. Koma zuwa All ko ƙirƙiri deterministic combo.
combos.readinessDescription: Duba jerin dubawa kafin ƙirƙira ko sabunta wannan combo.
combos.saveBlockedTitle: An hana ajiyewa har sai an gyara abubuwa masu zuwa:
combos.saveBlockPricing: Ƙara farashi ga aƙalla samfuri ɗaya ko zaɓi wata dabara.
combos.recommendationsLabel: Saitin da aka ba da shawara
combos.recommendationsApplied: An aiwatar da shawarwari ga wannan haɗin.
combos.intelligentPanelDesc: Ƙididdiga na ainihin lokaci da matsayin lafiyar wannan haɗin mai sarrafa turawa ta atomatik.
combos.configOnlyHint: Wannan sashe yana nuna bayanan shigar turawa kawai. Ana samun yanayin breaker na kai-tsaye a shafin Health.
combos.routingInputsHint: Kunshin yanayi da rabon nauyi suna nan; yanayin aikin breaker yana shafin Health.
combos.emailVisibilityHint: Imel ɗin asusu a nan suna bin maɓallin sirri na bai ɗaya.
combos.emailVisibilityTooltip: Yi amfani da alamar ido don nuna ko ɓoye imel ɗin asusu gaba ɗaya a duk haɗe-haɗe, providers da shafukan quota.
combos.builderModeGlobal: Binciken samfuri na bai ɗaya (Haɗin al'ada)
combos.builderGlobalSearchPlaceholder: Bincika samfura a duk providers (misali opus, sonnet, deepseek, kimi, qwen)...
combos.builderGlobalNoResults: Ba a sami samfuri don "{query}" ba.
combos.manualModelInvalid: Shigar da samfuri a matsayin provider/model.
combos.manualModelUnknownProvider: Prefix ɗin provider da ba a sani ba.
combos.builderNeedValidName: Sanya ingantaccen sunan haɗin kafin ci gaba.
combos.allProvidersHealthy: Providers suna bayar da rahoton cewa yanayin turawa yana da kyau.
combos.highCircuitBreakerRate: An gano yawan katsewar na’urar kariyar da’ira.
combos.modePackHint: Sauya saitunan da aka tanada don karkatar da injin zaɓin hanya ba tare da sake gina haɗin ba.
combos.allProvidersEvaluated: Ba a saita rukunin ’yan takara ba. Ana tantance duk masu bayarwa masu aiki yayin gudanarwa.

combos.candidatePoolHint: Zaɓi masu bayarwar da wannan injin ya kamata ya tantance. Bar shi babu komai don amfani da duk masu bayarwa masu aiki.
combos.candidatePoolEmpty: Har yanzu babu masu bayarwa masu aiki.
combos.explorationRateHint: Kashi {percent}% na buƙatu na iya gwada masu bayarwar da ba su fi dacewa ba.
combos.nestedComboExecute: Gudanar da haɗe-haɗe masu juna biyu a matsayin maƙasudai

priority.title: Tushen kariya idan an samu matsala
priority.description: Yi amfani da babban samfuri guda ɗaya, sannan kaƙaita jerin madadin ya zama gajere kuma abin dogaro.
priority.tip1: Sanya samfurinka mafi aminci a farko.
priority.tip2: Riƙe samfurin madadin 1-2 masu irin wannan inganci.
priority.tip3: Yi amfani da sake-gwaji masu aminci don shawo kan gazawar mai bayarwa ta wucin gadi.

weighted.title: Rarraba zirga-zirga mai sarrafawa
weighted.description: Ya dace sosai da ƙaddamarwar canary da ƙaura a hankali tsakanin samfura.
weighted.tip1: Fara da rabo mai taka-tsantsan kamar 90/10.
weighted.tip2: Tabbatar jimillar ta kasance 100%, sannan a daidaita ta atomatik bayan canje-canje.
weighted.tip3: Sa ido kan nasara da jinkiri kafin ƙara nauyin canary.

round-robin.title: Raba kaya mai iya hasashe
round-robin.description: Ya fi dacewa idan samfuran suna daidai kuma kana buƙatar rarrabawa cikin sauƙi.
round-robin.tip2: Saita iyakokin aiki lokaci guda don guje wa cunkoso na bazata.
round-robin.tip3: Yi amfani da wa'adin jerin jira domin gazawa cikin sauri lokacin da aka kai iyakar ɗaukar aiki.

random.title: Rarrabawa cikin sauri tare da ƙaramin saiti
random.description: Yi amfani da shi idan kana buƙatar rarrabawa mai sauƙi ba tare da tsauraran tabbaci ba.
random.tip1: Yi amfani da samfura masu halayen jinkiri iri ɗaya.
random.tip2: Bar sake-gwaji a kunne don shawo kan gazawar bazata.
random.tip3: Fi son wannan don gwaje-gwaje, ba don tsauraran SLA ba.

least-used.title: Daidaitawa mai sauyawa
least-used.description: Yana tura buƙatu zuwa samfuran da ba a cika amfani da su ba don rage cunkoson aiki a hankali.
least-used.tip1: Yana aiki mafi kyau a ƙarƙashin zirga-zirga mai ci gaba.
least-used.tip2: Haɗa shi da binciken lafiya don daidaitawa mafi aminci.
least-used.tip3: Bibiyi amfanin kowane samfur don tabbatar da ribar rarrabawa.

cost-optimized.title: Tura buƙatu bisa fifikon kasafin kuɗi
cost-optimized.description: Yana tura buƙatu zuwa samfura masu rahusa idan ana samun bayanan farashi.
cost-optimized.tip1: Tabbatar akwai bayanan farashi ga duk samfuran da aka zaɓa.
cost-optimized.tip2: Riƙe madadin mai inganci don umarni masu wahala.
cost-optimized.tip3: Yi amfani da shi don ayyukan rukuni ko na bayan-fage inda farashi ne babban KPI.

reset-aware.title: Jujjuya asusu bisa lokacin sake saiti
reset-aware.description: Yana daidaita ragowar kason mai bayarwa da lokacin sake saiti.
reset-aware.tip1: Yi amfani da matakan asusu a bayyane ko tura buƙatu ta alamar asusu ga masu bayarwa masu bayanan sa ido kan kaso.
reset-aware.tip2: Daidaita nauyin zama da na mako-mako idan ƙarewa cikin gajeren lokaci ya fi haɗari.
reset-aware.tip3: Riƙe tazarar daidaito ƙanƙanta domin asusun da suke daidai su ci gaba da juyawa cikin adalci.

strict-random.title: Rarrabawa ta gaurayen kati
strict-random.description: Ana amfani da kowane samfur sau ɗaya tak a kowane zagaye kafin a sake gaurayawa.
strict-random.tip1: Yi amfani da aƙalla samfura 2 don rarrabawa mai ma'ana.
strict-random.tip2: Yana aiki mafi kyau da samfura masu aiki iri ɗaya.
strict-random.tip3: Ya dace sosai da daidaita kaya tsakanin asusun API da yawa.

fill-first.description: Cinye kason masu bayarwa ɗaya bayan ɗaya kafin komawa ga madadin.
fill-first.tip1: Yi amfani da shi don tura buƙatu bisa kaso tare da sarƙoƙin madadin a bayyane.
fill-first.tip2: Saita ƙayyadaddun amfani daidai don guje wa komawa madadin da wuri.
fill-first.tip3: Yana aiki mafi kyau tare da masu samarwa da ke ba da matakan kyauta ko tarin kuɗin amfani.
fill-first.title: Ƙarewar Ƙayyadadden Amfani

auto.description: Yi zaɓin hanya bisa kimantawa ta ainihin lokaci ta fuskar kuɗi, jinkiri, inganci, da lafiyar aiki.
auto.tip1: Bar injin ya daidaita abubuwa da dama ta atomatik.
auto.tip2: Kula da abubuwan da ke tasiri ga yanke shawarar zaɓin hanya a cikin rajistan ayyuka.
auto.tip3: Yi amfani da shi don nau'ikan aiki masu sarƙaƙiya inda babu wani abu guda da ya fi sauran tasiri.
auto.title: Ingantawa Bisa Abubuwa da Dama

lkgp.description: Yi zaɓin hanya bisa aikin da ya gabata da tsarin nasara.
lkgp.tip1: Yana buƙatar isasshen tarihin buƙatu don yin hasashe daidai.
lkgp.tip2: Ya dace da nau'ikan aiki masu tsarin aikin samfuri mai daidaito.
lkgp.tip3: Kula da daidaiton hasashe kuma daidaita nauyi kamar yadda ake buƙata.
lkgp.title: Zaɓin Hanya Bisa Tarihi

context-optimized.description: Inganta zaɓin hanya bisa amfani da tagar mahallin bayani da ingancin token.
context-optimized.tip1: Tura dogayen tattaunawa zuwa samfura masu manyan tagogin mahallin bayani.
context-optimized.tip2: Kula da amfani da mahallin bayani don guje wa ɓarnatar da token.
context-optimized.tip3: Ya fi dacewa da AI na tattaunawa da ke buƙatar riƙe mahallin bayani mai yawa.
context-optimized.title: Inganta Mahallin Bayani

context-relay.description: Ya fi dacewa idan ana sa ran sauya asusu kuma dole ne asusu na gaba ya gaji sauƙaƙaƙƙen taƙaitaccen aikin.
context-relay.tip1: Yi amfani da shi tare da masu samarwa da ke sauya asusu don rukunin samfuri ɗaya.
context-relay.tip2: Saita iyakar miƙa aiki ƙasa da tsauraran iyakokin ƙayyadadden amfani domin samar da lokacin taƙaitawa.
context-relay.tip3: Saita keɓaɓɓen samfurin taƙaitawa kawai idan na farko ya yi tsada sosai ko ba shi da kwanciyar hankali.
context-relay.title: Fifikon Ci Gaban Zama

p2c.description: Tura zuwa mai samarwa da ke da mafi ƙarancin nauyin aiki a halin yanzu bisa ma'aunai na ainihin lokaci.
p2c.tip1: Kula da ma'aunan lafiyar masu samarwa don tantance nauyin aiki daidai.
p2c.tip2: Yana aiki mafi kyau tare da tarin masu samarwa masu halaye iri ɗaya.
p2c.tip3: Daidaita matakin saurin amsawa don guje wa kai-komo yayin ƙaruwar cunkoson zirga-zirga.
p2c.title: Ƙarfin Zaɓuɓɓuka Biyu

combos.templateFreeStackDesc: Rarrabawar bi-da-bi tsakanin dukkan masu samarwa na kyauta: Kiro (Claude), Qoder (samfura 5), Qwen (samfura 4). Babu kuɗi, kuma ba ya taɓa daina rubuta lamba.
combos.auto: Zaɓi na Atomatik Mai Kaifin Basira
combos.autoDesc: Tarin zaɓin hanya mai kaifin basira da ke gyara kansa ta hanyar kimantawa bisa abubuwa da dama
combos.lkgpDesc: Yana ba mai samarwa na ƙarshe da ya kammala buƙata cikin nasara fifiko
combos.wizardGuideDesc: Ƙirƙiri combos na samfura don tsara hanyar zirga-zirgar AI cikin basira
combos.wizardGuideHint: ko danna + Create Combo da ke sama
combos.wizardStep1Desc: Ba combo ɗinka suna na musamman don gane shi a cikin ƙa'idodin zaɓin hanya
combos.wizardStep2Desc: Zaɓi samfuran AI sannan ka tsara jerin fifikon madadinsu
combos.wizardStep3Desc: Zaɓi yadda ake rarraba buƙatu tsakanin samfuranka — akwai dabaru 14
combos.wizardStep4Desc: Duba saitunanka sannan ka kunna haɗakar

concept.title: Ƙwaƙwalwar Tattaunawa
concept.description: OmniRoute yana koyo daga kowace tattaunawa, yana tuna bayanai, abubuwan da suka faru, hanyoyin aiki, da ma'anoni waɗanda ke sa amsoshi su fi daidaito da fahimtar mahallin magana.
concept.howWorksContent:
1. Ciro bayanai ta atomatik: a ƙarshen kowace amsa, ana gano bayanai da abubuwan da suka faru sannan a adana su ta atomatik.
2. Maidowa: kafin kowace amsa, ana bincika ƙwaƙwalwar da ta fi dacewa ta hanyar FTS5 (daidai), vector (na ma'ana), ko hybrid RRF.
3. Shigarwa: ana shigar da ƙwaƙwalwar da ta dace cikin mahallin mataimaki don inganta ingancin amsa.
4. Gudanarwa: yi amfani da wannan shafin don dubawa, gyarawa, fitarwa, da matse tsofaffin ƙwaƙwalwa.

riskNotice.title: Kafin ci gaba
riskNotice.tooltip: Mai samarwa mai gargaɗin amfani — danna don cikakkun bayanai
riskNotice.oauth: Wannan mai samarwa yana amfani da zaman samfurinka na hukuma/OAuth, wanda ba a ba da izinin amfani da shi don proxy/router ba. Ba mu ba da shawarar yawan amfani da wakili mai sarrafa kansa ba (irin na OpenCloud, dogayen matakai masu yawa, manyan rukunai) — sabis na asali na iya mayar da martani ta hanyar taƙaita ko dakatar da asusun. Yi amfani da shi bisa kasadar kanka.
riskNotice.webCookie: Wannan mai samarwa yana tabbatar da shaidarka ta hanyar cookies na zaman yanar gizonka. Sabis na asali na iya soke zaman a kowane lokaci, wanda zai buƙaci ka sake shiga. Ba a ba da shawarar amfani da shi don dogayen ayyukan da ba a sa ido a kansu ba. Yi amfani da shi bisa kasadar kanka.
riskNotice.deprecated: Sabis ɗin asali ya dakatar da wannan mai samarwa, kuma yana iya daina aiki ba tare da sanarwa ba. Haɗin da ke akwai na iya ci gaba da aiki har sai sabis ɗin asali ya cire damar gaba ɗaya. Yi la’akari da wasu zaɓuɓɓuka.

providers.compatUpstreamHeadersHint: Saiti mai babban izini — yana da matakin amincewa iri ɗaya da gyara bayanan shaidar API na mai samarwa; amintattun masu gudanarwa kawai ya kamata su yi amfani da shi. Ana haɗa shi bayan OmniRoute ya ƙara tantancewa daga maɓallin API na mai samarwa. Idan take na musamman yana amfani da suna iri ɗaya da wanda yake akwai (misali Authorization), ƙimarka za ta maye gurbin taken da aka samar ta atomatik gaba ɗaya (har da alamar Bearer) — upstream zai ga abin da ka rubuta kawai, ba maɓallin da ke cikin saituna ba. Kuskuren saiti na iya haifar da 401 ko lalacewar tantancewar upstream. Layi ɗaya ga kowane take (misali ƙarin Authentication ga wasu gateways). Tsayar da linzamin kwamfuta a kai ko mayar da hankali kan ƙimar don ganin samfoti. Ana adanawa idan an bar filin, an danna waje, ko an rufe wannan panel.

providers.zedImportDescription: Gano bayanan tantancewar masu ba da AI (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, xAI) da Zed IDE ya adana a cikin ma'ajiyar maɓallan OS, sannan a shigo da su a matsayin haɗin kai. Dole ne a shigar da Zed IDE a wannan na'ura.

providers.zedManualDescription: Yi amfani da wannan idan OmniRoute yana gudana a Docker ko kuma babu damar amfani da ma'ajiyar maɓallai. Liƙa maɓallin API da Zed ya adana a <path>~/.config/zed/settings.json</path>, ko ka kwafe shi daga sashen saitunan Zed AI.

providers.cursorAgentNudgeBody: Sanya cursor-agent don sabunta zaman ta atomatik — idan babu shi, haɗin Cursor yana buƙatar sake haɗawa da hannu lokaci-lokaci, kusan kowane awa 24.

providers.grokImportDescription: Shigo da fayil ɗin Grok Build <authPath>~/.grok/auth.json</authPath>. Za ka iya samunsa ta hanyar gudanar da <command>grok login</command> a terminal ɗinka.
providers.grokInvalidAuth: Wannan ba ingantaccen fayil ɗin Grok Build auth.json ba ne. Ana tsammanin object mai key da ke ɗauke da JWT.

providers.grokRefreshMissing: Ba a sami refresh token ba — sake shigo da shi bayan token ɗin ya ƙare
providers.freeTierProvidersDesc: Masu samarwa da ke da tsare-tsaren kyauta — wasu suna buƙatar yin rajista don samun maɓallin API, wasu kuma ba sa buƙatar bayanan shiga kwata-kwata.
providers.ideProvidersDesc: Editoci masu tsarin biyan kuɗin AI da aka gina a ciki. Yi amfani da shafin mai samarwa don shigo da bayanan shiga kai tsaye daga ma'ajiyar maɓallan IDE.
providers.noIdeProviders: Babu masu samarwa na IDE da suka dace da matatun yanzu.

providers.providerDetailValidClaudeCredentialsFile: Ingantaccen fayil ɗin bayanan shiga na Claude

providers.webFetchTooltip: Masu samarwa da ke ciro abun ciki daga URLs na yanar gizo (HTML → Markdown, scrape, screenshot)
providers.webFetchProvidersHeading: Masu Samar da Dauko Bayanan Yanar Gizo
providers.compatibleProvidersDesc: OpenAI-compatible da Anthropic-compatible endpoints da kake karɓar baƙuncinsu ko saitawa. Nuna kowane OpenAI SDK zuwa URL naka, sannan ka bi da buƙatun ta nan.
providers.oauthProvidersDesc: Masu samarwa da ake tantancewa ta OAuth — shiga sau ɗaya, kuma OmniRoute zai kula da jujjuya token ta atomatik.
providers.webCookieProvidersDesc: Waɗannan masu samarwa suna amfani da zaman yanar gizo na burauza, cookies, ko web tokens maimakon API keys. Buɗe mai samarwa don ƙara bayanan zaman da ake buƙata.
providers.apiKeyProvidersDesc: Masu samarwa na daidaitattun API keys. Ƙara key naka sau ɗaya, sannan OmniRoute zai kula da turawa, sake gwadawa, da iyakance yawan buƙatu a madadinka.
providers.noAuthProvidersDesc: Buɗaɗɗun endpoints waɗanda ba sa buƙatar bayanan shiga — a shirye suke don amfani nan take ba tare da yin rajista ba.
providers.upstreamProxyProvidersDesc: Bi da zirga-zirgar bayanai masu fita ta upstream proxy kafin ta isa ga mai samarwa. Yana da amfani ga cibiyoyin sadarwar kamfanoni ko binciken zirga-zirgar bayanai.
providers.webFetchProvidersDesc: Masu samarwa da ke ɗaukowa da ciro abun ciki daga URLs na yanar gizo. Yi amfani da su don ɗaure prompts da bayanan yanar gizo na kai tsaye.
providers.aggregatorsGatewaysDesc: Masu tarawa daga masu samarwa da yawa da AI gateways waɗanda ke samar da API guda ɗaya mai haɗaka ga dimbin models na asali.
providers.enterpriseCloudDesc: Models na matakin kamfanoni da waɗanda ake karɓar baƙuncinsu a cloud, masu ingantattun SLAs, takardun shaida na bin ƙa’ida, da keɓaɓɓen ƙarfin aiki.
providers.cloudAgentProvidersDesc: Wakilan cloud masu cin gashin kansu waɗanda ke aiwatar da ayyuka masu ɗaukar dogon lokaci tare da amincewa da tsari da bin diddigin matsayi kai tsaye.
providers.localProvidersDesc: Models masu zaman kansu da ke gudana a kan hardware naka. Babu wani bayani da zai bar ababen more rayuwarka.
providers.searchProvidersDesc: Masu samar da binciken yanar gizo da takardu. Haɗa su da kiran LLM don Retrieval-Augmented Generation.
providers.audioProvidersDesc: Masu samar da text-to-speech da speech-to-text don voice I/O da hanyoyin aikin sauya audio zuwa rubutu.
providers.embeddingRerankProvidersDesc: Masu samar da vector embedding da reranking don binciken ma’ana, hanyoyin aikin RAG, da ƙididdigar kamanceceniya.
providers.imageProvidersDesc: Masu samar da ƙirƙirar hotuna da vision — ƙirƙiri hotuna daga rubutu ko nazarci waɗanda suke akwai.
providers.videoProvidersDesc: Masu samar da ƙirƙirar bidiyo. Ƙirƙiri gajerun shirye-shiryen bidiyo daga prompts na rubutu ko hotuna.
providers.onboardingWizard: Mataimakin Fara Amfani da Mai Samarwa
providers.onboardingWizardDescription: Haɗa masu samarwa na API-key, na musamman masu dacewa, da na OAuth tare da tabbatarwa, adanawa, da gwajin haɗi nan take.
providers.onboardingTypeApiKeyText: Yi amfani da masu samarwa da aka gina a ciki kamar OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, Azure, da sauransu.
providers.onboardingTypeCustomTitle: Mai samarwa na musamman mai jituwa
providers.onboardingTypeCustomText: Ƙirƙiri endpoint mai jituwa da OpenAI, Anthropic, ko Claude Code sannan ka ƙara key ɗinsa.
providers.onboardingTypeOAuthText: Sake amfani da hanyoyin OAuth, device-code, ko local import da ake da su don masu samar da coding.
providers.onboardingChooseProviderDescription: Zaɓi mai samarwa, sannan wizard zai jagorance ka wajen shigar da credentials da yin gwaji.
providers.onboardingApiKeyOptional: API key ba dole ba ne
providers.onboardingProviderSavedWithWarnings: An adana mai samarwa tare da gargaɗi
providers.onboardingCreatingCompatibleProvider: Ana ƙirƙirar mai samarwa mai jituwa…
providers.onboardingSavingCompatibleConnection: Ana adana haɗin mai samarwa mai jituwa…
providers.onboardingCustomProviderFailed: Saita mai samarwa na musamman ya gaza
providers.onboardingOAuthNoConnectionFound: An kammala OAuth, amma ba a sami haɗin mai samarwa ba.
providers.onboardingBaseUrlOverrideHint: Ba dole ba ne. Ana adana shi a matsayin providerSpecificData.baseUrl.
providers.onboardingProviderSpecificIdPlaceholder: ID na musamman ga mai samarwa wanda ba dole ba ne
providers.onboardingCreateCustomCompatibleProvider: Ƙirƙiri mai bayarwa na musamman mai jituwa
providers.onboardingCreateCustomCompatibleDescript: Jagoran yana fara ƙirƙirar kumburin mai bayarwa, sannan ya adana kuma ya gwada haɗin API-key ɗinsa.
providers.onboardingProviderPrefixHint: Ana amfani da shi don samar da id na mai bayarwa da ake sarrafawa.
providers.onboardingOAuthFlowDescription: OmniRoute zai buɗe tsarin OAuth da ake da shi na wannan mai bayarwa. Bayan shiga, jagoran zai sake loda haɗin da aka adana sannan ya gudanar da gwajin haɗi iri ɗaya da na shafin mai bayarwa.

onboardingProviderDescriptions.agentrouter: Samu kuɗin amfani na $200 kyauta a https://agentrouter.org/register — ba a buƙatar katin kuɗi.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.unorouter: Ƙirƙiri API key a https://unorouter.ai, sannan liƙa shi a nan a matsayin Bearer token.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.aimlapi: An dakatar da matakin kyauta (2026) — yanzu AI/ML API na biyan gwargwadon amfani ne kawai (mafi ƙarancin ƙarin kuɗi $20); babu kuɗin amfani na kyauta da ke maimaituwa.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.ai21: Kuɗin gwaji na $10 bayan yin rajista (yana aiki na tsawon watanni 3), ba a buƙatar katin kuɗi
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bailian-coding-plan: Haɗa Alibaba Coding Plan da API key.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bedrock: Haɗin Bedrock na asali: gano samfura yana amfani da Bedrock foundation models da inference profiles, yayin da taɗi ke amfani da APIs na Bedrock Runtime Converse/ConverseStream na yankin.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.ant-ling: Yi rajista kuma ƙirƙiri API key a na'urar sarrafa Ant Ling API (https://chat.ant-ling.com/open), sannan liƙa shi a nan. OmniRoute yana tura zirga-zirgar taɗi zuwa https://api.ant-ling.com/v1/chat/completions; mai bayarwar ya dace da OpenAI kuma yana samar da hanyar mu'amala mai jituwa da Anthropic.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.api-airforce: Samu API key ɗinka daga https://panel.api.airforce — endpoint mai jituwa da OpenAI a https://api.airforce/v1
onboardingProviderDescriptions.azure-ai: Foundry yana amfani da hanyar mu'amalar OpenAI v1 tare da sunayen deployment a matsayin samfura. OmniRoute yana daidaita tushen URLs na albarkatu zuwa endpoints na taɗin v1 da /models.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.azure-openai: Yi amfani da Azure OpenAI API key ɗinka. Base URL ya kamata ya zama endpoint na albarkatunka, misali https://my-resource.openai.azure.com.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bai: Bearer API key don ƙofar LLM ta b.ai mai jituwa da OpenAI (dabam da TheB.AI). Ƙirƙiri key a https://docs.b.ai, sannan yi amfani da https://api.b.ai/v1 a matsayin OpenAI-compatible base URL.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.qianfan: Yi amfani da Qianfan API key daga Baidu AI Cloud. Tsohon endpoint ɗin da aka saita yana jituwa da OpenAI v2.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.baseten: Kuɗin gwaji na $30 kyauta don GPU inference
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bazaarlink: Ƙirƙiri API key kyauta a https://bazaarlink.ai — samfurin 'auto:free' yana tura buƙatu zuwa inference marar kuɗi. Duk samfura suna amfani da tsarin provider/model-name, misali xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.black-forest-labs: Haɗa Black Forest Labs da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.blackbox: Matakin kyauta: hira ta asali mara iyaka tare da Minimax-M2.5, ba a buƙatar katin kuɗi
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bluesminds: Sami maɓallin API ɗinka a https://www.bluesminds.com — endpoint mai dacewa da OpenAI a https://api.bluesminds.com/v1 tare da credits na yau da kullum kyauta. Samfuran VIP (Claude Opus 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Pro) suna cinye pi credits.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.byteplus: Haɗa BytePlus ModelArk da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.bytez: Credits na kyauta na $1, ana sabunta su duk bayan makonni 4
onboardingProviderDescriptions.cerebras: Credit na rajista na $5 na sau ɗaya (yana aiki na kwanaki 30); ana buƙatar hanyar biyan kuɗi. Wannan ba matakin kyauta mai maimaituwa ba ne.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.charm-hyper: Ƙirƙiri maɓallin API a https://hyper.charm.land, sannan liƙa shi a nan a matsayin Bearer token.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.chutes: Maɓallin Bearer API don gateway na Chutes mai dacewa da OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.clarifai: Clarifai yana samar da hira, responses da /models masu dacewa da OpenAI a /v2/ext/openai/v1. Samfuran jama'a/al'umma galibi suna buƙatar PAT; maɓallan da aka keɓe wa app suna aiki ne kawai da albarkatun da ke cikin wannan app.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.cloudflare-ai: Yana buƙatar API Token DA Account ID (ana samunsu a dash.cloudflare.com)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.clova-studio: CLOVA Studio (HyperCLOVA X) yana dacewa da OpenAI a /v1/openai. OmniRoute yana binciken /v1/openai/models kuma yana tura zirga-zirgar hira zuwa /v1/openai/chat/completions. Yana amfani da host na yanzu clovastudio.stream.ntruss.com — ana daina amfani da tsohon endpoint na clovastudio.apigw.ntruss.com.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.cohere: Gwaji Kyauta: kiran API 1,000/wata don gwaji, ba a buƙatar katin kuɗi
onboardingProviderDescriptions.command-code: Ƙirƙiri ko kwafi maɓallin API daga Command Code, sannan liƙa shi a nan a matsayin Bearer token.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.datarobot: Tsohon gateway yana lissafa samfura masu aiki daga /genai/llmgw/catalog/. Haka kuma ana goyon bayan URLs na deployment don buƙatun hira kai tsaye masu dacewa da OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.deepinfra: Credits na rajista kyauta don gwajin API da binciken samfura
onboardingProviderDescriptions.deepseek: Tokens miliyan 5 kyauta yayin rajista — ba a buƙatar katin kuɗi
onboardingProviderDescriptions.dgrid: Ƙirƙiri maɓallin DGrid API a https://dgrid.ai, sannan yi amfani da https://api.dgrid.ai/v1 a matsayin base URL mai dacewa da OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.dify: Sami maɓallin API daga instance ɗinka na Dify.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.dit: dit.ai (Distributed Intelligence Trade) router/gateway ne mai dacewa da OpenAI, tare da farashi mai sauyawa ga kowace buƙata, yana samar da /v1/chat/completions a https://api.dit.ai/v1. OmniRoute yana amfani da ƙa'idar OpenAI; nazarin kashe kuɗi/ajiyar kuɗi yana cikin dashboard na dit.ai.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.empower: Empower yana samar da hira mai dacewa da OpenAI a https://app.empower.dev/api/v1 tare da goyon bayan kiran kayan aiki a empower-functions.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.factory: Sami maɓallin Factory API ɗinka a https://app.factory.ai/settings/api-keys, sannan liƙa shi a matsayin Bearer token. Endpoint mai dacewa da OpenAI yana a https://api.factory.ai/v1.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.featherless-ai: Akwai matakin kyauta — ba a buƙatar katin kuɗi
onboardingProviderDescriptions.fenayai: Maɓallin Bearer API don gateway na FenayAI mai dacewa da OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.fireworks: Credits na farawa na $1 kyauta yayin rajista don gwajin API
onboardingProviderDescriptions.freeaiapikey: Proxy na API mai rangwame don samfura 40+ da suka haɗa da GPT-5, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Qwen 3.5. Sami maɓallin API ɗinka a https://freeaiapikey.com/dashboard. Base URL: https://freeaiapikey.com/v1.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.freemodel-dev: Sami credits na API na $300 kyauta a https://freemodel.dev — ba a buƙatar bayanan biyan kuɗi. Endpoint mai dacewa da OpenAI. Akwai samfuran GPT-5.4 da GPT-5.5.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.friendliai: Matakin kyauta don inference mara sabar — ba a buƙatar katin kuɗi
onboardingProviderDescriptions.gemini: Matakin kyauta ta Google AI Studio; ba a ƙara wallafa ƙa'idodin iyaka na kowane samfuri ba (duba shafin quota a AI Studio) — ba a buƙatar katin kuɗi.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.gitlab: GitLab personal access token don API na Code Suggestions na jama'a. Saita base URL mai zaman kansa idan ba a amfani da gitlab.com.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.gitlawb-gmi: Sami maɓallin API ɗinka daga dashboard na Gitlawb Opengateway.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.gitlawb: Sami maɓallin API ɗinka daga dashboard na Gitlawb Opengateway.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.glm: Haɗa GLM Coding da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.glm-cn: Haɗa GLM Coding (China) da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.glmt: Tsararren bayanin martaba na GLM mai ƙarin kasafin token, an kunna tunani, kuma yana da tsawon lokacin ƙarewa.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.groq: Tsarin kyauta: iyakoki bisa kowane samfuri (token 200K/rana ga kowane samfurin hira; duba console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits don RPM/RPD) — babu hanyar biyan kuɗi a fayil.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.heroku: Haɗa Heroku AI da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.huggingface: API na Inference kyauta don dubban samfura (Whisper, VITS, SDXL…)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.hyperbolic: Kiredit ɗin gwaji na $1-5 yayin yin rajista don inference mara sabar
onboardingProviderDescriptions.watsonx: Ƙofar samfurin watsonx tana samar da /chat/completions da /models masu jituwa da OpenAI a ƙarƙashin /ml/gateway/v1.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.inception: Inception Labs yana dacewa da OpenAI a https://api.inceptionlabs.ai/v1. mercury-2 shi ne diffusion LLM (dLLM) na farko a kundin — yana samarwa cikin sauri sau 5-10 fiye da makamantan samfuran autoregressive, tare da kiran kayan aiki, json_mode, da tsararrun fitarwa.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.inference-net: Kiredit kyauta na $25 yayin yin rajista, sannan akwai tallafin bincike
onboardingProviderDescriptions.internlm: Kason kyauta na wata-wata ~token shigarwa 1M / token fitarwa 3M (~10 RPM)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.jina-ai: Maɓallin Bearer API don api.jina.ai (embeddings, rerank, classify, segment, search). Ba katin Reader / r.jina.ai ba ne. Maɓallan dashboard suna da fifiko a kan JINA_AI_API_KEY.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.jina-reader: Maɓallin Bearer API don sauya URL zuwa markdown kawai ta r.jina.ai. Ba ya samar da /v1/embeddings ko /v1/rerank. Token ɗin Jina ɗaya da na Foundation API yana aiki.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.kenari: Kenari yana samar da wurin ƙarshe na chat completions mai jituwa da OpenAI a https://kenari.id/v1/chat/completions, tare da kundin /v1/models kai-tsaye wanda ya ƙunshi Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi da sauransu. OmniRoute yana amfani da yarjejeniyar OpenAI kuma yana jera samfura ta hanyar passthrough.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.kilo-gateway: Haɗa Kilo Gateway da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.kimi-coding-apikey: Haɗa Kimi Coding (API Key) da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.lambda-ai: Haɗa Lambda AI da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.laozhang: Haɗa LaoZhang AI da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.llm7: Yana aiki ba tare da maɓallin API ba (yi amfani da 'unused' a matsayin maɓalli). Sami token kyauta a token.llm7.io don ƙarin iyakoki.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.longcat: Kyauta: tallafin token 10M na lokaci ɗaya bayan rajistar asusu + tabbatarwar KYC (LongCat-2.0). Na lokaci ɗaya ne kawai — ba izinin yau da kullum/wata-wata mai maimaituwa ba ne.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.meta-llama: Haɗa Meta Llama API da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.minimax: Haɗa Minimax Coding da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.mistral: Matakin Experiment kyauta: damar amfani da duk samfura mai iyakance ƙimar buƙatu, ba a buƙatar katin kiredit
onboardingProviderDescriptions.modal: Modal yawanci yana samar da manhajojin da masu amfani suka karɓi bakunci masu jituwa da OpenAI a /v1. OmniRoute zai bincika /v1/models kuma ya tura zirga-zirgar hira zuwa /v1/chat/completions.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.modelscope: Matakin kyauta ta ModelScope API-Inference — ana buƙatar asusun Alibaba.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.nebius: Kimanin $1 na kiredit ɗin gwaji bayan yin rajista don gwajin API
onboardingProviderDescriptions.nlpcloud: NLP Cloud yana amfani da API na chatbot na mallaka maimakon OpenAI chat/completions. OmniRoute yana daidaita saƙonnin OpenAI zuwa input/context/history kuma yana samar da kundin cikin gida na samfuran chatbot da ake tallafawa.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.nous-research: Nous yana samar da tsarin /v1 mai dacewa da OpenAI tare da babban kundin /models na nesa. Ƙarshen /chat/completions yana buƙatar ingantaccen maɓallin API don yin inference ta shirye-shirye.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.novita: $0.50 na kiredit ɗin gwaji bayan yin rajista (yana aiki na kusan shekara 1)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.nscale: $5 na kiredit kyauta bayan yin rajista don gwajin inference
onboardingProviderDescriptions.nvidia: Samun damar haɓakawa kyauta: kimanin 40 RPM, samfura 70+ (Kimi K2.5, GLM 4.7, DeepSeek V3.2...)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.oci: OCI yana samar da wuraren ƙarshen chat da responses masu dacewa da OpenAI. Project ID ba dole ba ne a OmniRoute, amma ana iya buƙatarsa don Responses da ayyukan wakilai.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.ollama-cloud: Haɗa Ollama Cloud da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.openadapter: OpenAdapter yana samar da ƙarshen chat completions mai dacewa da OpenAI a https://api.openadapter.in/v1/chat/completions, yana haɗa samfuran buɗaɗɗen tushe 70+ (DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, MiniMax, GLM, Llama, Mistral, …). OmniRoute yana amfani da tsarin OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.opencode-go: Haɗa OpenCode Go da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.opencode-zen: Haɗa OpenCode Zen da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.openrouter: Samfura kyauta a $0/token masu ƙarin :free - 20 RPM / 200 RPD
onboardingProviderDescriptions.openvecta: Kiredit kyauta bayan yin rajista don inference mai dacewa da OpenAI a faɗin LLMs, embeddings, da samfuran reasoning
onboardingProviderDescriptions.orcarouter: Ƙirƙiri maɓallin API (yana farawa da sk-orca-) a https://www.orcarouter.ai, sannan liƙa shi a matsayin Bearer token. Ƙarshen da ya dace da OpenAI yana https://api.orcarouter.ai/v1.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.ovhcloud: Haɗa OVHcloud AI da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.pioneer: $75 na kiredit ɗin amfani kyauta — ba a buƙatar katin kuɗi
onboardingProviderDescriptions.plamo: PLaMo yana dacewa da OpenAI a https://api.platform.preferredai.jp/v1. Preferred Networks ne ya gina shi kuma an inganta shi don Jafananci. Takardun bayanai galibi suna cikin Jafananci.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.poe: Poe yana samar da chat da responses masu dacewa da OpenAI a https://api.poe.com/v1, tare da binciken ma'auni mai tabbatar da izini a /usage/current_balance.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.pollinations: Matakin kyauta ba tare da maɓalli ba: openai, openai-fast, openai-large, qwen-coder, mistral, deepseek, grok, gemini-flash-lite-3.1, perplexity-fast, perplexity-reasoning. Samfuran Premium (claude, gemini, midijourney) suna buƙatar maɓallin Pollinations API daga enter.pollinations.ai.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.publicai: Yana buƙatar maɓallin API — kiredit na rajista na sau ɗaya, sannan biyan kuɗi
onboardingProviderDescriptions.qiniu: Ƙirƙiri maɓallin API na Qiniu AI inference a https://portal.qiniu.com/ai-inference/api-key, sannan liƙa shi a nan a matsayin Bearer token. Ƙarshen da ya dace da OpenAI yana https://api.qnaigc.com/v1, yana wakiltar DeepSeek, Claude, Kimi da ƙari a bayan maɓalli guda.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.reka: Reka Chat yana dacewa da OpenAI a /v1. OmniRoute yana binciken /v1/models kuma yana tura zirga-zirgar chat zuwa /v1/chat/completions.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.requesty: Ƙirƙiri maɓallin API a https://app.requesty.ai, sannan liƙa shi a nan a matsayin Bearer token. Ƙarshen da ya dace da OpenAI yana https://router.requesty.ai/v1, tare da kundin /v1/models kai tsaye.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.runwayml: Samar da bidiyo na Runway yana dogara ne kan ayyuka. OmniRoute yana miƙa ayyukan text-to-video ko image-to-video, yana duba /v1/tasks/[id] lokaci-lokaci, sannan yana daidaita sakamakon bidiyon da aka kammala zuwa martanin /v1/videos/generations mai kama da na OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.sambanova: $5 na kiredit kyauta bayan yin rajista (yana aiki na kwanaki 30), ba a buƙatar katin kuɗi
onboardingProviderDescriptions.seekai: Ƙirƙiri maɓallin API a https://seekai.cc, sannan liƙa shi a nan a matsayin Bearer token. Tushen URL mai dacewa da OpenAI: https://seekai.cc/v1.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.sap: Gano samfura yana amfani da /v2/lm/scenarios/foundation-models/models a AI_API_URL. Buƙatun chat suna amfani da deploymentUrl/chat/completions kuma suna buƙatar AI-Resource-Group.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.sarvam: Sarvam AI yana dacewa da OpenAI a /v1. OmniRoute yana binciken /v1/models kuma yana tura zirga-zirgar chat zuwa /v1/chat/completions. An daidaita samfuran don harsunan Indic.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.scaleway: Tokens 1M kyauta ga sababbin asusu — ya dace da EU/GDPR (Paris), Qwen3 235B & Llama 70B
onboardingProviderDescriptions.siliconflow: $1 na kiredit kyauta tare da samfura masu kyauta na dindindin bayan tabbatar da ainihi
onboardingProviderDescriptions.snowflake: Haɗa Snowflake Cortex da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.stability-ai: Haɗa Stability AI ta amfani da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.sumopod: SumoPod yana samar da wurin ƙarshen kammala tattaunawa mai dacewa da OpenAI a https://ai.sumopod.com/v1/chat/completions, tare da kundin /v1/models mai aiki kai tsaye. OmniRoute yana amfani da ƙa'idar OpenAI kuma yana jera samfura ta hanyar passthrough.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.suno: Manna session cookie daga suno.ai (Clerk auth)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.synthetic: Haɗa Synthetic ta amfani da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.thebai: Maɓallin API na Bearer don ƙofar TheB.AI mai dacewa da OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.together: Haɗa Together AI ta amfani da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.tokenrouter: TokenRouter yana samar da wurin ƙarshen kammala tattaunawa mai dacewa da OpenAI a https://api.tokenrouter.com/v1/chat/completions, tare da kundin /v1/models mai aiki. OmniRoute yana amfani da ƙa'idar OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.topaz: Haɗa Topaz ta amfani da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.typhoon: Typhoon yana dacewa da OpenAI a /v1. SCB 10X (Thailand) ne ya gina shi; typhoon-v2.5-30b-a3b-instruct samfuri ne mai fifita harshen Thai kuma mai yaruka da yawa.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.udio: Manna session cookie daga udio.com (Supabase auth)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.uncloseai: Ba a buƙatar auth. API yana karɓar kowace kirtani marar fanko a matsayin maɓallin ganowa.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.upstage: Haɗa Upstage ta amfani da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.v0-vercel: Haɗa v0 (Vercel) ta amfani da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.venice: Haɗa Venice.ai ta amfani da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.vercel-ai-gateway: Haɗa Vercel AI Gateway ta amfani da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.vertex: Samar da Service Account JSON ko OAuth access_token
onboardingProviderDescriptions.vertex-partner: Samar da Service Account JSON ɗin da aka yi amfani da shi don samfuran abokan hulɗar Vertex AI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.volcengine: Haɗa Volcengine ta amfani da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.voyage-ai: Maɓallin API na Bearer don API ɗin embeddings da rerank na Voyage AI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.wandb: Haɗa Weights & Biases Inference ta amfani da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.writer: Writer Palmyra yana dacewa da OpenAI a https://api.writer.com/v1. palmyra-x5 yana samar da taga mahalli mai token miliyan 1.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.x5lab: X5Lab yana samar da wurin ƙarshen kammala tattaunawa mai dacewa da OpenAI a https://api.x5lab.dev/v1/chat/completions, tare da kundin /v1/models mai aiki kai tsaye. OmniRoute yana amfani da ƙa'idar OpenAI kuma yana jera samfura ta hanyar passthrough.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.xai: Haɗa xAI (Grok) ta amfani da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.xiaomi-mimo: Haɗa Xiaomi MiMo ta amfani da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.zenmux: ZenMux yana samar da wurin ƙarshen kammala tattaunawa mai dacewa da OpenAI a /api/v1/chat/completions, tare da hanyoyin ƙa'idar Anthropic Messages (/api/anthropic/v1/messages) da Google Gemini (/api/vertex-ai). OmniRoute yana amfani da ƙa'idar OpenAI.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.galadriel: Haɗa Galadriel ta amfani da maɓallin API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.predibase: Kiredit na gwaji kyauta na $25 (yana aiki na kwanaki 30)
onboardingProviderDescriptions.chenzk: Ƙofa mai dacewa da OpenAI wadda ke da kundin samfura mai aiki kai tsaye a chenzk.top.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.freetheai: Ƙofa kyauta mai dacewa da OpenAI tare da goyon bayan samfura ta hanyar passthrough.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.g4f-gemini: Ƙofar g4f.space ta nesa zuwa Gemini. Samun dama ba tare da suna ba yana buƙatar kiredit na proof-of-work daga g4f.dev/chat ko maɓallin API na memba daga g4f.dev/members.html; iyakoki suna bambanta.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.g4f-groq: Ƙofar g4f.space ta nesa zuwa Groq. Samun dama ba tare da suna ba yana buƙatar kiredit na proof-of-work daga g4f.dev/chat ko maɓallin API na memba daga g4f.dev/members.html; iyakoki suna bambanta.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.g4f-nvidia: Ƙofar g4f.space ta nesa zuwa NVIDIA NIM. Samun dama ba tare da suna ba yana buƙatar kiredit na proof-of-work daga g4f.dev/chat ko maɓallin API na memba daga g4f.dev/members.html; iyakoki suna bambanta.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.g4f-ollama: Ƙofar g4f.space ta nesa zuwa Ollama. Samun dama ba tare da suna ba yana buƙatar kiredit na proof-of-work daga g4f.dev/chat ko maɓallin API na memba daga g4f.dev/members.html; iyakoki suna bambanta.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.g4f-pollinations: Ƙofar g4f.space ta nesa zuwa Pollinations. Samun dama ba tare da bayyana suna ba yana buƙatar ƙididdigar proof-of-work daga g4f.dev/chat ko maɓallin API na memba daga g4f.dev/members.html; iyakoki suna bambanta.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.mixedbread: Ƙirƙiri embeddings ta amfani da Mixedbread API.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.segmind: Samar da hotuna da bidiyoyi ta amfani da samfurorin da Segmind ke karɓar baƙuncinsu.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.amazon-q: Yana amfani da AWS Builder ID iri ɗaya ko tsarin refresh-token da aka shigo da shi kamar Kiro, amma yana ware haɗin Amazon Q daban.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.antigravity: Haɗa Antigravity ta amfani da tsarin OAuth na yanzu.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.agy: Shigo da bayanan shiga na Antigravity CLI (`agy`) ɗinka (liƙa/loda fayil ɗin token ɗinsa), gano bayanan shiga na CLI na gida ta atomatik, ko shiga da Google. Yana amfani da backend na Antigravity tare (har da samfuran Claude).
onboardingProviderDescriptions.claude: Haɗa Claude Code ta amfani da tsarin OAuth na yanzu.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.cline: Haɗa Cline ta amfani da tsarin OAuth na yanzu.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.cursor: Haɗa Cursor IDE ta amfani da tsarin OAuth na yanzu.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.cursor-api: Haɗa Cursor da maɓallin API na mai amfani (crsr_...) daga cursor.com/dashboard/api; ba a buƙatar zaman IDE.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.github: Haɗa GitHub Copilot ta amfani da tsarin OAuth na yanzu.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.gitlab-duo: Manhajar OAuth mai scopes na ai_features + read_user. Saita GITLAB_DUO_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID da kuma, idan ana so, GITLAB_DUO_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET a wannan instance na OmniRoute.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.kilocode: Haɗa Kilo Code ta amfani da tsarin OAuth na yanzu.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.kimi-coding: Haɗa Kimi Coding ta amfani da tsarin OAuth na yanzu.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.kiro: Matakin kyauta: credits 50/wata (~25K–100K tokens). ⚠️ Kiro ToS ya hana amfani da proxy/harness na ɓangare na uku.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.codex: Haɗa OpenAI Codex ta amfani da tsarin OAuth na yanzu.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.qwen: Haɗa Qwen Code ta amfani da tsarin OAuth na yanzu.
onboardingProviderDescriptions.github-models: Ƙirƙiri GitHub PAT mai scope na 'models: read' a github.com/settings/tokens

providers.passthroughModelsDescription: {provider} yana karɓar ID na samfuri na asalin provider. Shigo da su daga /models ko ƙara ID na musamman don routing.
providers.bedrockModelsDescription: Ana iyakance samfuran Amazon Bedrock bisa yankin AWS. Shigo da su daga /models ko ƙara ID na samfuran Bedrock da aka kunna a yankin da aka zaɓa.
providers.webCookieCredentialHint: Cookie da ake buƙata: {credential}. Liƙa ƙimar Cookie header daga zaman yanar gizon {provider} naka da ka shiga. Kada ka haɗa prefix ɗin Cookie:.
providers.webTokenCredentialHint: Bayanan shaida: {credential}. Liƙa ƙimar token daga zaman yanar gizon {provider} naka da ka shiga, ko DevTools HAR export idan provider ɗin yana goyon bayansa.
providers.webCookieEditHint: Bar shi babu komai don ci gaba da amfani da cookie na zaman yanzu. Cookie da ake buƙata: {credential}.
providers.webTokenEditHint: Bar shi babu komai don ci gaba da amfani da token na zaman yanar gizo na yanzu. Bayanan shaida: {credential}.
providers.webSessionGuideTitle: Yadda ake samun bayanan shaidar zaman
providers.webSessionGuideIntro: {provider} yana amfani da zaman yanar gizo na browser maimakon maɓallin API.
providers.webSessionGuideStep2: Buɗe kayan aikin developer na browser sannan ka bincika request da web app ɗin ya aika.
providers.webSessionGuideStep2Fast: Hanya mafi sauri: shigar da extension na Cookie Editor (chromewebstore.google.com → Cookie Editor), buɗe shi a tab ɗin {provider}, nemo {credential} (zaɓi duk numbered chunks idan an raba shi), sannan danna Export → Copy tare da saita export format zuwa “Cookie header”.
providers.webSessionGuideStep3: Kwafi bayanan shaida da ake buƙata daga domain na provider ɗin kansa. Don cookies, kwafi ƙimar Cookie header kawai kuma ka bar Cookie:.
providers.webSessionGuideStep3Manual: Hanyar hannu: buɗe kayan aikin developer na browser (F12 → Network), sake loda shafin, buɗe authenticated request, sannan kwafi ƙimar Cookie header daga Request Headers — ka bar prefix ɗin Cookie:.
providers.webSessionGuideStep4: Manna shi a nan sannan ka duba haɗin. Idan ya daina aiki, sake shiga sannan ka maye gurbinsa da sabuwar ƙima.
providers.harImportButtonHint: Fitar da shi daga shafin Network na DevTools bayan aika aƙalla saƙon taɗi guda ɗaya.
providers.harImportStatusValid: An shigo da shi — yana aiki na kusan minti {minutes}.
providers.harImportStatusExpiringSoon: An shigo da shi — saura kusan minti {minutes} kacal kafin ya daina aiki.
providers.harImportStatusExpired: An shigo da shi, amma wannan token ya riga ya daina aiki (minti {minutes} da suka wuce) — fitar da sabon HAR.
providers.harImportStatusUnknownExpiry: An shigo da shi. Ba a iya karanta lokacin ƙarewar aikinsa ba.
providers.harImportErrorNotJson: Wannan fayil ɗin ba ingantaccen JSON ba ne — shin da gaske fitarwar .har ce?
providers.harImportErrorNoEntries: Wannan HAR ba shi da bayanan ayyukan hanyar sadarwa da aka naɗa.
providers.harImportErrorNoChathubUrl: Ba a sami haɗin taɗi na Copilot a cikin wannan HAR ba. Aika aƙalla saƙon taɗi guda ɗaya a m365.cloud.microsoft kafin fitarwa.
providers.harImportErrorUnparsableUrl: An sami haɗin taɗin, amma ba a iya karanta URL ɗinsa ba.
providers.harImportErrorMissingFields: An sami haɗin taɗin, amma babu token a cikinsa.
providers.harImportErrorReadFailed: Ba a iya karanta wannan fayil ɗin ba.
providers.harImportErrorUnknown: Ba a iya ciro bayanan shiga daga wannan fayil ɗin HAR ba.
providers.webSessionSecurityHint: Ɗauki wannan kamar kalmar sirri: yana iya ba da damar shiga asusun yanar gizon da ka shiga har sai ya daina aiki ko an soke shi.
providers.webNoAuthGuideBody: {provider} ba ya buƙatar maɓallin API ko cookie. Ajiye haɗin don amfani da endpoint ɗinsa na yanar gizo kyauta.
providers.webSessionCredentialValidationFailed: Tabbatar da bayanan shiga na zaman ya gaza. Sake shiga, kwafi sabbin bayanan shiga, sannan ka sake gwadawa.
providers.huggingchatDesc: Taɗi na LLM kyauta ta huggingface.co/chat
providers.poeWebDesc: Taɗi mai samfura da yawa ta poe.com
providers.veniceWebDesc: Taɗin AI mai mayar da hankali kan kare sirri
providers.v0VercelWebDesc: Samar da lambar kwamfuta ta AI ta v0.dev
providers.kimiWebDesc: Taɗin AI na masu amfani na Moonshot AI ta www.kimi.com (na ƙasa da ƙasa, Connect-RPC API)
providers.doubaoWebDesc: Taɗin AI na ByteDance ta dola.com
providers.overrideBaseUrlAdvanced: Na ci gaba: sauya ainihin URL
providers.overrideBaseUrlHint: Na ci gaba: karkatar da wannan ginannen mai samarwa zuwa endpoint na musamman. Bar shi babu komai don amfani da na asali.
providers.apiProtocolHint: Wasu masu samarwa suna wallafa samfura iri ɗaya ta ka'idoji fiye da ɗaya. Bar na asali sai idan kana buƙatar madadin.
providers.bulkAddFormatHintCloudflare: Maɓalli ɗaya a kowane layi. Tsari: name|accountId|apiKey (ID na asusun Cloudflare + token na API).
providers.lmarenaWebCookieHint: Buɗe arena.ai, shiga, sannan ka kwafi cikakken taken Cookie daga buƙatar Network. Haɗa arena-auth-prod-v1.0 da arena-auth-prod-v1.1 (da sauran gutsuttsura idan suna nan), zai fi kyau tare da cf_clearance. Kada ka manna cookie na arena-auth-prod-v1 marar komai kaɗai. Na zaɓi: providerSpecificData.recaptchaV3Token idan create-evaluation har yanzu yana mayar da 403.
providers.kimiOfficialSupporterTooltip: Kimi (Moonshot AI) abokin ƙaddamar da OmniRoute ne na hukuma
providers.cheaperInferenceSupporterTooltip: Cheaper Inference yana tallafa wa OmniRoute a matsayin Abokin Buɗaɗɗen Tushe
providers.kimiPartnerLinkNote: Haɗin abokin hulɗa — yana tallafa wa OmniRoute ba tare da ƙarin kuɗi a gare ku ba
providers.anonymousFallbackTitle: Madadin da ba a bayyana suna ba
providers.anonymousFallbackDesc: Lokacin da duk haɗin da aka saita suka ƙare (kaso, kuɗin asusu, ko wa'adin aiki), a yi amfani da matakin wannan mai samarwa wanda baya buƙatar maɓalli na ɗan lokaci. Kashe wannan don tsallake wannan mai samarwa maimakon aika buƙatu ba tare da bayyana suna ba — ana ba da shawarar hakan idan matakin da baya buƙatar maɓalli yana ƙin su (401).
providers.anonymousFallbackEnabled: An kunna madadin da ba a bayyana suna ba don {provider}
providers.anonymousFallbackDisabled: An kashe madadin da ba a bayyana suna ba don {provider} — za a tsallake wannan mai samarwa idan haɗin sun ƙare
providers.anonymousFallbackUpdateFailed: An kasa sabunta saitin madadin da ba a bayyana suna ba

settings.title: Saituna
settings.routingSettingsIntro: Yana sarrafa yadda ake jagorantar buƙatunka, sauya su, da aika su zuwa masu samar da AI.
settings.routingOpDropParagraphContainsDesc: Yana cire duk wani sakin layi (tubalin rubutu da aka raba ta layuka marasa komai) a cikin umarnin tsarin wanda rubutunsa ya ƙunshi KOWANNE daga cikin ƙananan jerin kalmomin da aka lissafa. Yi amfani da shi don cire alamomin gane abokan ciniki na ɓangare na uku kamar 'github.com/anomalyco/opencode' ko 'docs.openwebui.com' waɗanda na'urar tantancewa ta Anthropic ke yi wa alama.
settings.routingOpDropParagraphStartsWithDesc: Yana cire duk wani sakin layi da YA FARA DA ɗaya daga cikin farkon kalmomin da aka lissafa. Yi amfani da shi don layukan shaida kamar 'You are OpenCode' ko 'You are Open WebUI' waɗanda ke bayyana abokin cinikin da ke yin kiran.
settings.routingOpReplaceTextDesc: Yana sauya takamaiman ƙaramin jerin rubutu da wani takamaiman ƙaramin jerin rubutu. Yi amfani da shi don sanannun jimlolin tayar da aiki — misali, sake rubuta 'Here is some useful information about the environment you are running in:' zuwa 'Environment context you are running in:' (jimlar tayar da aiki da aka tabbatar ta hanyar gwaji).
settings.routingOpReplaceRegexDesc: Yana sauya rubutun da ya dace da regular expression. Yi amfani da shi lokacin da kake buƙatar tsare-tsare (rukunin haruffa, fararen sarari na zaɓi, anchors) maimakon takamaiman ƙananan jerin rubutu. Ana gano tsarin da bai inganta ba a lokacin aiki yayin da op ɗin yake gudana.
settings.routingOpDropBlockContainsDesc: Yana cire DUKKAN tubalan system (ba sakin layi kaɗai ba) waɗanda rubutunsu ya ƙunshi kowane ɗaya daga cikin ƙananan jimlolin da aka jera. Yi amfani da wannan idan gaba ɗaya tubalin yana ɗauke da alamar ganowa kuma kana son a cire shi — misali, bayanin MCP-server da aka saka.
settings.routingOpPrependSystemBlockDesc: Yana saka sabon tubalin rubutu a FARKON jerin system. Yi amfani da shi don ƙara shaidar SDK mai cewa 'You are a Claude agent, built on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK.' wadda mai tantancewar Anthropic ke sa ran samu.
settings.routingOpAppendSystemBlockDesc: Yana saka sabon tubalin rubutu a ƘARSHEN jerin system. Yi amfani da shi don ƙarin gyaran kamanni waɗanda ba sai sun kasance a matsayi [0] ba.
settings.routingOpInjectBillingHeaderDesc: Yana ƙara tubalin rubutu na musamman 'x-anthropic-billing-header: cc_version=...; cc_entrypoint=...; cch=...;' a gaba, wanda mai tantancewar Anthropic ke ingantawa. Ana buƙatarsa don wuraren relay na gadar CC; ga native claude provider kuwa, OmniRoute ya riga ya saka nasa layin billing, don haka wannan op yawanci ba shi da amfani a can.
settings.routingOpObfuscateWordsDesc: Yana saka harafin Zero-Width-Joiner bayan harafin farko na kowace kalmar da aka jera, ta yadda 'opencode' zai zama 'opencode'. Ga mutane karatunsa iri ɗaya ne, amma yana kauce wa daidaitawar kalmomi ta mai tantancewa. Yana aiki kan tubalan system, saƙonnin user/assistant, da bayanan tool.
settings.routingNeedlesHint: Jerin ƙananan jimloli. Sakin layi zai dace idan ya ƙunshi KOWANE ɗaya daga cikinsu. Ƙara ɗaya a kowane layi ta hanyar 'Add entry'.
settings.routingPrefixesHint: Jerin jimloli. Sakin layi zai dace idan ya fara da kowane ɗaya daga cikinsu (ana cire sararin fari na farko kafin daidaitawa).
settings.routingCaseSensitiveHint: Idan yana ON, 'OpenCode' da 'opencode' jimloli ne daban. Idan yana OFF (tsoho), kwatantawar ba ta kula da bambancin manyan da ƙananan haruffa.
settings.routingMatchLiteralHint: Ainihin ƙaramar jimlar da za a nemo. Babu tsarin regex — ana ɗaukar alamomi na musamman kamar . * ? a matsayin kansu.
settings.routingReplacementTextHint: Jimlar maye gurbi. Bar ta babu komai don share abin da ya dace. Sakamakon zai kiyaye rubutun da ke kewaye.
settings.routingAllOccurrencesHint: Idan yana ON (tsoho), ana maye gurbin kowane abin da ya dace. Idan yana OFF, abin da ya dace na farko kaɗai ake maye gurbi.
settings.routingPatternHint: Tushen JavaScript regex. Kada a naɗe shi da slashes — kawai 'foo(.*)bar'. Server zai ƙi patterns waɗanda suka kasa compile.
settings.routingRegexFlagsHint: Tutocin JavaScript regex (g = duk abubuwan da suka dace, i = rashin kula da manyan/ƙananan haruffa, s = dot yana dacewa da sabon layi, m = layuka da yawa). Tsoho shi ne 'g'.
settings.routingBlockTextHint: Cikakken rubutun sabon tubalin system. Yi amfani da literal string; tubalin system yana adana rubutu kaɗai.
settings.routingIdempotencyKeyHint: Na zaɓi. Idan an saita shi, op zai tsallake idan akwai tubali wanda rubutunsa ya fara da wannan key. Yana hana maimaita prepend yayin sake gwadawa.
settings.routingBillingEntrypointHint: Ƙimar da ake saka wa a matsayin 'cc_entrypoint='. Anthropic yana karɓar 'sdk-cli' (Agent SDK), 'cli' (Claude Code CLI), ko wasu ƙimomin da aka rubuta a takardu.
settings.routingBillingVersionFormatHint: Yadda ake lissafa build hash mai haruffa 3 bayan cc_version=. 'ex-machina' = sha256 na CCH_SALT+haruffa-daga-saƙon-user-na-farko+version (ga kowane saƙo). 'omniroute-daystamp' = sha256 na YYYY-MM-DD+version (yana tabbata na tsawon rana).
settings.routingBillingCchAlgoHint: Yadda ake lissafa token mai haruffa 5 na cch=. 'sha256-first-user' = sha256 na rubutun saƙon user na farko. 'xxhash64-body' = sa hannu a matakin body zai cika shi daga baya. 'static-zero' = placeholder na zahiri '00000'.
settings.routingObfuscateWordsHint: Kalmomin ƙananan haruffa da za a ɓoye. Ana saka ZWJ ba tare da la'akari da bambancin manyan da ƙananan haruffa ba, don haka 'opencode' zai kuma dace da 'OpenCode' da 'OPENCODE'.
settings.routingObfuscateTargetsHint: Sassan body da za a bincika don kalmomin: tubalan system, saƙonnin user/assistant, da/ko bayanan tool.

omniglyph.description: Matsa mahallin bayani a matsayin hoto. Yana mayar da umarnin tsarin, takardun kayan aiki, da tarihin da ke cike da bayanai zuwa ƙananan shafukan PNG domin hanyar Claude Fable 5 da aka auna. Kunshin OmniGlyph da aka wallafa yana kuma samar da masu sauyawa na asali na GPT 5.6, amma OmniRoute yana barin waɗannan hanyoyin a rufe idan an samu gazawa har sai an tabbatar da amincin mai samarwa da rasitocin karantawa.

model.label: Samfuri
model.why: Hanyar Fable 5 da aka auna kaɗai ce aka kunna a OmniRoute. Kunshin yana goyon bayan GPT 5.6 ta fuskar tsari, amma har yanzu an toshe shi har sai an samu rasitin mai samar da shi; iyalai da ba a tabbatar da su ba kamar Grok suna ci gaba da amfani da rubutu kawai.

transport.label: Isarwa
transport.why: Masu tarawa na iya sake ɗaukar samfurin hotuna su lalata sauƙin karantawa — hanyar mai samarwa kai tsaye kaɗai ce abin dogaro.

format.label: Tsari
format.why: Dole ne jikin ya dace da tsarin isarwar mai samarwa: Claude Messages, OpenAI Chat Completions, ko shigarwar OpenAI Responses input[] ta asali.

profitable.label: Mai riba
profitable.why: Ƙofar ainihin kuɗin facin 28px ce ke yanke shawara ga kowace buƙata; ƙaramin rubutu ko wanda ba shi da cunkoso yana wucewa ba tare da an taɓa shi ba.

omniglyph.enableDescription: Yana aiki a ƙarshe cikin jerin bayan injinan rubutu sun tsaftace buƙatar, ta amfani da tsarin isarwar mai samarwa na asali; ana matsa buƙatun OpenAI Chat/Responses bayan fassara domin a kiyaye tsarinsu. Haka kuma yana iya aiki shi kaɗai ta yanayin omniglyph. Wannan samfoti ne kuma yana kasancewa a kashe ta tsohuwa har sai an kammala tabbatarwa daga farko zuwa ƙarshe.
omniglyph.profileDescription: Bayanan martaba iyaka ce ta sama, ba ta ƙasa ba: ba za a iya sassauta bayanan martaba masu tsauri ta hanyar keɓancewar kowane mataki ba. An auna wannan a wannan codebase: tare da coding-safe ko balanced, zaman da bai tara tarihi ba tukuna ba ya matse komai, domin dukansu suna ƙara mafi ƙarancin adadin haruffa kuma suna barin system prompt, tool schemas da tool results a yanayinsu na asali.

aggressive.label: Mai tsauri (tsoho)
aggressive.description: Manufar da rasitocin da aka wallafa suka auna. Yana hotanta system prompt, takardun kayan aiki da tarihin da yake da yawa.

balanced.label: Daidaitacce
balanced.description: Yana barin yanayin aiki na yanzu a asalinsa kuma yana kare zagaye 8 na ƙarshe; yana taƙaita tsohon tarihin da aka rufe kawai.

codingSafe.label: Mai aminci ga coding
codingSafe.description: Yana barin iko, tool schemas da sakamakon kayan aiki na yanzu a asalinsu, tare da kare zagaye 12 na ƙarshe. Ba ya matse komai har sai zaman ya tara tarihi.

passthrough.label: Wucewa kai tsaye
passthrough.description: Yana sarrafa hanya ba tare da sauya komai ba. Ana tsallake engine ɗin kuma a tura buƙatar yadda take ba tare da an taɓa ta ba.

translator.title: Mai Fassara
translator.metaDescription: Yi debug, gwaji, da nuna fassarar tsarin API tsakanin providers
translator.modeDescriptionPlayground: Liƙa kowane jikin buƙatar API ka ga yadda OmniRoute ke fassara shi tsakanin tsarin masu samarwa (OpenAI ↔ Claude ↔ Gemini ↔ Responses API)
translator.modeDescriptionChatTester: Aika ainihin buƙatun taɗi ta OmniRoute sannan ka bincika cikakken zagayen: shigarwa, buƙatar da aka fassara, amsar mai samarwa, da sakamakon da aka fassara.
translator.modeDescriptionTestBench: Gudanar da yanayin gwaji da aka riga aka tsara sannan ka kwatanta dacewa tsakanin masu samarwa da samfura.
translator.modeDescriptionLiveMonitor: Kalli abubuwan fassara kai tsaye yayin da buƙatu ke gudana ta OmniRoute.
translator.modeDescriptionFallback: Gano matsala, gwada, kuma nuna yadda OmniRoute ke fassara buƙatun API tsakanin masu samarwa.
translator.liveAutoRefreshing: Kai tsaye — Ana sabuntawa ta atomatik
translator.eventsAppearHint: Abubuwan fassara suna bayyana a nan yayin da buƙatu ke gudana ta OmniRoute. Yi amfani da ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan hanyoyin don samar da abubuwa:
translator.inMemoryNote: Lura: Ana adana abubuwa a ƙwaƙwalwa kuma ana sake saita su idan uwar garken ta sake farawa.
translator.formatConverterDescription: Liƙa ko rubuta jikin buƙatar JSON. Mai fassarar zai gano tsarin tushe ta atomatik sannan ya sauya shi zuwa tsarin manufa. Yi amfani da wannan don gano yadda OmniRoute ke fassara buƙatu tsakanin tsare-tsare (OpenAI ↔ Claude ↔ Gemini ↔ Responses API).
translator.translationPathPassthrough: Tsari iri ɗaya — ba a buƙatar fassara
translator.autoFeaturesTitle: Abin da OmniRoute ke yi ta atomatik
translator.featureReasoningCacheDesc: Yana sake saka reasoning_content da aka adana domin samfuran yanayin tunani (DeepSeek V4, Kimi K2, Qwen) idan abokan ciniki ba su saka shi cikin tarihin tattaunawa ba.
translator.featureSchemaCoercionDesc: Yana gyara tsarin kayan aiki da ya lalace: yana ƙara additionalProperties da suka ɓace, yana tsaftace dogayen bayanai, kuma yana daidaita abubuwa masu shiga cikin juna.
translator.featureRoleNormalizationDesc: Yana sauya developer→system ga wuraren da ba na OpenAI ba. Yana sauya system→user ga samfurorin da ba sa goyon bayan matsayin system.
translator.featureToolCallIds: Daidaita ID na Kiran Kayan Aiki
translator.featureToolCallIdsDesc: Yana samar da tool_call IDs na musamman idan babu su. Yana daidaita su zuwa tsarin haruffa 9 ga masu samarwa kamar Mistral.
translator.featureMissingToolResponseDesc: Yana shigar da saƙonnin tool_result marasa komai idan abokan ciniki suka aika tool_calls ba tare da amsoshin da suka dace ba.
translator.featureThinkingBudgetDesc: Sarrafa filayen buƙatar tunani/tsokaci a matakin proxy: passthrough (abokin ciniki ne ke sarrafawa), auto (cire duk sigogin tunani), custom (tsayayyen kasafi), ko adaptive (daidaitawa bisa wahala). Wannan ya bambanta da matsawa da zaɓin hanya. Ba ya warware ɓoyayyen abun cikin tsokaci.
translator.featureDirectPathsDesc: Wasu nau'ukan tsarin da aka haɗa (Claude→Gemini) suna da masu fassara kai tsaye waɗanda ke tsallake cibiyar OpenAI, suna samar da sakamako mafi daidai.
translator.featureImageMappingDesc: Yana fassara ƙa'idojin girman hoto tsakanin tsarin API (misali, matakan dalla-dalla na OpenAI → girman Gemini).

translator.testBenchDescription: Gudanar da tsararrun gwaje-gwaje (Hira Mai Sauƙi, Kiran Kayan Aiki, da sauransu) don tabbatar da fassara da dacewa da mai samarwa. Zaɓi tsarin tushe da mai samarwar da ake nufi, sannan gudanar da duk gwaje-gwaje don ganin kaso na dacewa. Yi amfani da wannan don gano fasalolin da ke aiki tsakanin masu samarwa.

landing.heroDescription: Wakilin wurin haɗin AI mai dashboard na yanar gizo - Sigar JavaScript ta CLIProxyAPI. Yana aiki cikin sauƙi tare da Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cline, RooCode, da sauran kayan aikin CLI.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Duk abin da kake buƙata don sarrafa ababen more rayuwa na AI a wuri guda, an gina shi don faɗaɗawa.
landing.featureUnifiedEndpointDesc: Samun dama ga duk masu samarwa ta hanyar daidaitaccen URL na API guda ɗaya.
landing.featureEasySetupDesc: Fara aiki cikin mintuna ta amfani da umarnin npx.
landing.featureModelFallbackDesc: Sauya masu samarwa ta atomatik idan an sami gazawa ko jinkiri mai yawa.
landing.featureUsageTrackingDesc: Cikakken nazari da sa ido kan kuɗi a duk samfura.
landing.featureOAuthApiKeysDesc: Sarrafa bayanan shiga cikin aminci a ma'ajiya guda ɗaya.
landing.featureCloudSyncDesc: Daidaita saitunanka tsakanin na'urori nan take.
landing.featureCliSupportDesc: Yana aiki tare da Claude Code, Codex, Cline, Cursor, da sauransu.
landing.featureDashboardDesc: Dashboard na gani don nazarin zirga-zirga a ainihin lokaci.
landing.howItWorksDescription: Bayanai suna gudana cikin sauƙi daga manhajarka ta cikin matakinmu na sarrafa hanyoyi mai basira zuwa mafi kyawun mai samarwa don aikin.
landing.howItWorksStep1Description: Buƙatunku suna farawa daga kayan aikin da kuka fi so ko SDK ɗinmu haɗaɗɗe. Kawai ku canza URL na tushe.
landing.howItWorksStep2Description: Injinmu yana nazarin umarnin, yana duba lafiyar masu samar da sabis, sannan yana zaɓar hanya mafi ƙarancin jinkiri ko kuɗi.
landing.howItWorksStep3Description: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, ko wasu suna aiwatar da buƙatar nan take.
landing.getStartedDescription: Shigar da OmniRoute, saita masu samar da sabis ɗinku ta dashboard na yanar gizo, sannan ku fara karkatar da buƙatun AI.
landing.installStepDescription: Gudanar da umarnin npx don fara sabar nan take
landing.openDashboardStepDescription: Saita masu samar da sabis da maɓallan API ta hanyar mahaɗin yanar gizo
landing.routeRequestsStepDescription: Nuna kayan aikin CLI ɗinku zuwa {endpoint}
landing.configureProvidersNote: 📝 Saita masu samar da sabis a dashboard ko amfani da masu canjin muhalli
landing.footerTagline: Haɗaɗɗen endpoint don samarwa ta AI. Haɗa, karkatar, da sarrafa masu samar da AI ɗinku cikin sauƙi.
landing.interactiveDiagram: Ana iya ganin zane mai mu'amala a kan kwamfutar tebur
landing.ctaTitle: A Shirye Kuke Don Sauƙaƙa Kayan Aikin AI Naku?
landing.ctaDescription: Ku haɗu da masu haɓaka software waɗanda ke sauƙaƙa haɗa AI ɗinsu da OmniRoute. Buɗaɗɗen tushe ne kuma kyauta ne don farawa.
landing.footerDescription: Haɗaɗɗiyar hanyar mu'amala don kayan aikin AI na zamani. Amintacciya, mai sauƙin sa ido, kuma mai iya faɗaɗawa.

docs.docsHeroDescription: Ƙofar AI don LLM na masu samarwa da yawa. Wurin haɗi guda ɗaya don OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, da wasu masu samarwa sama da 20.

docs.quickStartStep2Text: Je zuwa Endpoint -> Registered Keys. Ƙirƙiri maɓalli guda ɗaya ga kowane muhalli.
docs.quickStartStep3Text: Ƙara asusun masu samarwa ta hanyar shiga da OAuth, maɓallin API, ko haɗin kai ta atomatik na matakin kyauta.
